title: Codename: RTS
author: ZenZonZan
selftext:
**I’ve been building an old-school RTS on and off for a year—and I’d love some beta players!**

Hey everyone! I wanted to share a project I’ve been working on over the past year.

It’s an old-school **Real Time Strategy game**—think Age of Empires / classic Warcraft. Start with a small settlement, build an economy, explore the map, raise an army, and try to survive your neighbors 😄

It’s come a long way, and I finally have a gameplay trailer and a downloadable Windows beta!

[Main Menu](https://preview.redd.it/ttxw4rz49bph1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=40f42aaef7952f6d3df33a9aa35117504cdf885b)

  


**So, what’s in it?**

* 🌲 **3 resources—gold, wood, and food.** Build up your economy, expand toward fresh resources, and keep those armies fed.
* 🏰 **12 building types**, from Farms and Barracks to defensive towers and Siege Workshops.
* ⚔️ **9 unit types across two factions**, including infantry, cavalry, Horse Archers, Axemen, healers, and Ballistas.
* 🔥 **Stone, Bronze, and Iron Ages.** Advance your civilization, watch your settlement transform, and upgrade your army.
* 🔧 **6 research paths with three levels each**, alongside military unit upgrades.
* 🗺️ **Randomly generated maps every game**, with fog of war, scouting, and new terrain to fight over.
* 🎯 Formations, control groups, a minimap, and save/load.

Right now, it’s single-player against AI, and I’ve put a lot of work into making the opponents give you a proper fight. There are **four personalities—aggressive, economic, defensive, and balanced—with three difficulty settings**.

  
Or you can just put the AI against itself and watch the chaos unfold. That’s surprisingly entertaining.

[Battle](https://preview.redd.it/061o8ib99bph1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=1a4c7e31519ef382029a323babd29a3530e9955e)



**A little behind the scenes:** it’s built in Python/Pygame, with a lot of help from Claude Code and Codex. Almost all the graphics were generated with ChatGPT, and the background music with Gemini.

🎬 [**Watch the 42-second gameplay trailer**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9bWxDqkOkM8)

🎮 [**Download the free Windows beta**](https://github.com/ilankt/RTS/releases/latest)

📖 [**GitHub, screenshots, and player guide**](https://github.com/ilankt/RTS)

**I’m looking for beta players—and I really mean it when I ask for feedback.**

Was the economy fun to build? Did the AI keep you on your toes? Did you get confused, bored, or completely wiped out before you knew what happened?

Positive or negative, all of that helps. Even a few sentences after one match would mean a lot.

Thanks!
